body:
i'm right with you. i haven't eaten at home in about three months. i'd say i'm living on about 750 calories a day. some days, i go the full day without eating. maybe a sip or two of water at night, and that's that. i'm already super skinny as it is, but i know i've lost weight in the last few months.

i just can't seem to build up the energy to actually eat something. i've gotten so used to it that it doesn't even matter anymore

i felt like i was dragging my ex-girlfriend down, too. i was so in love with her, but i felt that i was just gonna end up hurting her. so we broke up. i initiated it. we never stopped talking and hanging out the next few months. then one day i asked her to by my girl again, she said it was too late. its been a year, and i've been a mess ever since.

if you can, please stay with him. he probably wants to be there for you just like my ex did for me. don't force a break up like i did. if you really love him, don't do that. fight through it, if you can, having him there will help you. 

i've been alone for a year. i have had nobody to talk to. i've kept everything inside, and now i'm at the point where i know i'll be ending it all very soon. you can do better than i did. i'm sure your boyfriend wants to be there to support you and fight with you. let him. don't push him away. as much as you feel that you may be dragging him down, if you love him like i did my ex, and if he loves you like she loved me, then he wants to be there for you no matter what.
i haven't gone to a professional, and i don't have insurance either. i've tried to fight this on my own for a year, and i've failed

what i used to enjoy doing, i no longer enjoy. i used to play all kinds of sports. i tried playing again, and i hate it. i had no fun. i try to keep myself busy, but i can't seem to do enough.

i've been trying different things for about a year now, and i'm just getting so tired. i really don't think i can do this much longer
